sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your proposal; the fixed order volume represents our full demand for this part, and the longer contract term would provide planning security as demand is rising. Could your pricing committee review the offer in light of this commitment?

Our forecast for this part is up 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

Our forecast for this part is up 9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised proposal and your commitment to a 36-month contract. Please note that the additional volume forecast data you provided has already been factored into our previous calculation. 

However, we value our relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and are very keen to keep you as a satisfied customer. To reach an agreement, we are prepared to make a further concession and offer €5.51 per unit. 

Under this revised Angebot, we can present a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
